第67章 刀疤脸调戏老板娘-《赶山1957：二斤猪肉换个媳妇》

李青山自然也感受到了花韵的举动，开口道：“老板娘，我看你这面色不太好啊，要不要我给你把把脉看看？”

这倒不是李青山吹嘘，老板娘的脸色确实有些不太对劲！

“咋了，你还会切脉不成？”

“小小年纪，鬼主意倒是不少。”

花韵只当是李青山想要占自己便宜，却也是乖乖的将手伸了出去，手指纤细，手腕白皙如雪，能够清晰看到血管。

李青山也不客气，伸手朝着上面一搭！！

旋即，眉头微挑，颇为怪异的上下打量了一眼老板娘，还有老板娘身后的老板。

“嘶……这个嘛……！”李青山收回了手，不知道该怎么说。

“咋了，你倒是说说看，姐这是得了什么病？”黄韵媚音十足的开口问道。

“老板娘，你这个……！”

“行了，以后别喊我老板娘，叫我韵姐就行了。”黄韵开口道。

“行吧！”

“这个，韵姐……！”

李青山朝着黄韵面前凑了凑，小声道：“你男人，是不是不太行啊？”

话音刚落。

黄韵先是微微一怔，旋即脸上流露出一抹惊诧之色，上下打量着眼前的李青山道：“你怎么知道？”

自家男人十几岁的时候，进了老林子出来后，就不行了！

至于在老林子里面发生了什么，那就没人知道了，反正自家男人现在也不说。

说起来，自己是这男人的第二任妻子。

第一人妻子就是因为受不了这个，才跑走了，然后又娶得自己，这件事情也是在婚后才知道的，不过当时年纪小，嫁了就嫁了吧，加上他们家条件不错，能吃饱饭，就这么过了。

后来，邻居都说自己是不下蛋的母鸡。

自己心里没鬼，就感觉无所谓，也没有反驳，这么多年过来了，也没几个人知道自家男人不行。

这小后生，怎么一下看出来了？

“姐，你这黄花大闺女的身子可做不得假，就因为年纪大了，但是没有正常的生活，导致体内阴阳失调，脸上的皮肤有些暗沉……！”

李青山将花韵的症状一一讲述出来，而且十分精准，全部都对的上，这让花韵脸上流露出一抹惊诧道：“竟然全对了？你还真会看病啊？”

“那是自然！”李青山得意的点头道。

Li Qingshan naturally felt Hua Yun's actions and said, "Madam boss, I think you don't look good. Do you want me to check your pulse?"

This isn't Li Qingshan's boast, there is indeed something wrong with the boss lady's expression!

"What's wrong, can you still feel your pulse?"

"At such a young age, I have a lot of clever ideas."

Hua Yun thought it was Li Qingshan who wanted to take advantage of her, but she obediently stretched out her hand. Her fingers were slender, her wrist was as white as snow, and her blood vessels could be clearly seen.

Li Qingshan was not polite and extended his hand towards the top!!

Immediately, he raised his eyebrows slightly and looked up and down strangely at the landlady and the boss behind the landlady.

"Hey... this...!" Li Qingshan retracted his hand, not knowing what to say.

"What's wrong? You should tell me, what disease does sister have?" Huang Yunmei asked in a charming voice.

"Lady boss, you...!"

"Okay, don't call me boss lady from now on, just call me Sister Yun." Huang Yun said.

"Okay!"

"This, Sister Yun...!"

Li Qingshan moved closer to Huang Yun and whispered: "Aren't you a bad man?"

The words just fell.

Huang Yun was slightly startled at first, and then a look of surprise appeared on her face. She looked up and down at Li Qingshan in front of her and said, "How do you know?"

When my man was a teenager, he went into the old forest and came out, and he couldn't do it anymore!

As for what happened in the old forest, no one knows, and anyway, the man in his family won't say anything now.

Speaking of which, she is this man's second wife.

The first wife ran away because she couldn't bear this, and then married herself. She only found out about this after they got married, but she was young at the time, so she just got married. Plus, their family was in good condition and they had enough to eat, so they just got over it.

Later, the neighbors said that he was a hen that did not lay eggs.

I didn't have any trouble in my heart, so I felt it didn't matter, and I didn't refute it. After so many years, not many people knew that my man was not good.

How could this little youngster see it all at once?

"Sister, you, a pretty young girl, can't fake your body. Just because you are old and don't have a normal life, the yin and yang in your body are out of balance, and the skin on your face is a little dull...!"

Li Qingshan described Hua Yun's symptoms one by one, and he was very accurate. They were all correct, which made Hua Yun look surprised and said: "They are all correct? Do you really know how to treat a doctor?"

"That's natural!" Li Qingshan nodded proudly.
